pivot_rationale: Declared in the #11 catalog-comparator commit: the #11 primary null (rankscore ~= expression-only at pursuit discrimination) is consistent with clinical pursuit being expression-driven; the safety/tractability axes encode FAILURE risk, so the redirected surface tests discontinuation among pursued antigens (user steering rule 2026-09-29 16:03).
population: 205-gene corpus restricted to clinically pursued genes: strict_onc_total >= 1 in results/clintrials_per_gene.csv. Class counts verified BEFORE any outcome fit: 43 pursued, 11 fully inactive, 32 active.
label: fully_inactive = strict_onc_active == 0 (proxy for program discontinuation; conflates completed and terminated programs - exploratory, limitation disclosed)
predictors: the five frozen rankscore axes from #11 (tumor_signal, normal_safety, protein_breadth, tractability, nonessentiality), frozen weights (.30/.25/.15/.15/.15), same per-gene missing-axis renormalization and exclusion rules as #11 amendment fa1918e; comparator = expression-only (tumor_signal)
primary_endpoint: AUROC difference (rankscore - expression-only) for fully_inactive label, 10k bootstrap 95% CI (seed 20260929). SUPERIOR if CI excludes 0 above; INFERIOR if below; else NOT DEMONSTRATED.
secondary: per-axis AUROCs, descriptive only (no multiplicity family).
gate: requires >=10 genes per class (met: 11 vs 32, declared pre-fit); otherwise underpowered and stop.
